notes.title: Version 1.1 Acheivements
notes.content: A new version has been released and achievements have been added to the game.

notes.title: Bugfixes in v1.0.2
notes.content:
v1.0.2 is downloadable now. It contains a few small bug fixes.
[list]
[*] Tutorial text spelling errors corrected.
[*] Tutorial storm tower information clarified.
[*] Prevented incorrect towers being placed during tutorial.
[*] Corrected an issue with pausing during the Wave Start timer.
[/list]
